$comment: The arc reactor as an instrument (Reactor II, docs/design/c2-reactor.html): one geometry on every surface. Radii are fractions of R, the drawable radius (half the size minus a 4px margin). Read by jarvis-web/src/lib/ui/reactor.test.ts against Reactor.svelte and by android-app/tools/reactor_orb_test.py against ReactorOrb.kt, so the two renderers cannot drift by being retuned in step by hand. Periods are named tokens in design/tokens.json (motion.reactor.*), not seconds, because a duration is a design value.
